messages:
Alex: quick pulse — i need short updates from owners on the dedicated capacity buildout: procurement ETA, racks/power, network/VLAN, reservations, canary plan. TL;DR bullets please.
Maya: procurement: H100 order confirmed w/ vendor, ETA 2/27 -> expected dock 3/3. shipping manifest sent to infra. no customs flags so far. :thumbsup:
Jin: racks/power: 80% of PDUs racked, need final AC feed on rack 12 & 13. vendor scheduled 3/1 for final feed. blocking: datacenter needs signed SOP for hot-swap window.
Priya: network: VLANs prepped, BGP sessions tested in staging. still pending firewall rule PR (Q: who can review?). aiming to merge tomorrow.
Chris: reservations: I reconciled reservation table — we have gap for zone-eu-west-1 on 3/10-3/14 due to maintenance blackout. proposing temporary quota bump in alternate region. tagging @Maya for cost ok.
Dana: SRE/canary: canary plan drafted, 3-phase rollout (smoke -> 10% -> 100%). need final runbook and rollback play for kernel panic case. running one smoke in staging on 3/4.
Evan: infra changes (terraform) ready, small var rename to support multi-sku. PR: https://git.redwood/infr/terraform/pulls/456 — pinging @Jin and @Priya for net/infra cross-check.
Priya: ACKed PR, will review tonight. FYI I left a note about firewall rule ordering (could affect healthchecks).
Maya: cost check: tentative spend for first month ~ $Xk after reserved discounts. can confirm when reservations are finalized.
Alex: infra-bot: can you post the latest manifest?
infra-bot: manifest uploaded: s3://redwood-infra/manifests/2026-03-15/dock_manifest.csv — checksum ok.
Jin: small blocker — rack 13 has a missing patch-panel, vendor quoting 24-48h lead. contingency: we can put two racks in different pods to avoid single point.
Chris: proposal accepted. please assign ownership for the alternate pod move if needed.
Dana: assign SRE owners: me + Evan for canary ops, Priya for network flaps, Jin for rack change verification.
Alex: action items: Maya confirm cost + final PO, Jin confirm rack feed ticket closed, Priya merge firewall PR, Chris finalize reservation patch, Dana/Evan run staging smoke 3/4. I'll consolidate into a short status email to partners by EOD.
Maya: will confirm PO by 1700 PST.
Jin: rack feed scheduled and ticket updated — linking ticket: https://tickets.redwood/infra/7891
Priya: firewall PR merged.
Chris: reservation patch done, submitting request for quota bump in alt region.
Dana: staging smoke scheduled 03/04 09:00 PT. tagging SRE rotation. :rocket:
Alex: perfect — if anything slips, drop a one-line update here. otherwise i'll send the summary at 1700. :eyes:
